questions.question: What does David declare about his heart in Psalm 108?
options: It is faint; he longs for God in a parched dry land
It is troubled; he cries out in the night
It is steadfast; he will sing and make melody
It is proud; he must humble it before God
questions.answer: It is steadfast; he will sing and make melody

questions.question: What does the psalm conclude about human help?
options: Sweet is the quiet sleep of the one who fully trusts the LORD
Vain is the salvation of man; with God we shall do valiantly
Precious is the death of all the saints in the sight of the LORD
Better is a little possession together with the fear of the LORD
questions.answer: Vain is the salvation of man; with God we shall do valiantly

questions.question: David says he will give thanks to the LORD among the peoples and sing praises among the nations.
My heart is _____, O God! I will sing and make melody with all my being!
With God we will perform with _____; it is He who will trample our foes.
